## Phase: 2 - Automated Testing

### install.sh behavior
from: [[file:install]]
retrieved: 2026-05-15

- install.sh copies exactly 3 files: py-init/SKILL.md, nana-soul.md, .nana-dev-kit-path
- .nana-dev-kit-path stores the kit's absolute path (used by tests to verify content)
- install.sh is idempotent: running twice produces identical results (diff-verifiable)

### sync-rules.sh behavior
from: [[file:scripts-sync-rules]]
retrieved: 2026-05-15

- sync-rules.sh writes exactly 4 output files: CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .cursor/rules/main.mdc
- All outputs include "AUTO-GENERATED" header comment (testable marker)
- Cursor output (.mdc) has YAML frontmatter; missing AGENTS.md should exit non-zero

### Template placeholder convention
from: [[decision:structural-placeholder-verification]]
retrieved: 2026-05-15

- Templates use {{PACKAGE_NAME}}, {{PROJECT_DESCRIPTION}}, {{PROJECT_NAME}} placeholders
- /py-init substitutes these at scaffold time (not scriptable from bash)
- Tests verify placeholder presence via grep, not substitution correctness
